what_is.heading: What Are V-Bucks and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: V-Bucks are Fortnite's in-game currency. You spend them in the Item Shop on skins, emotes, pickaxes, gliders and wraps, and on passes like the Battle Pass, which costs 800 V-Bucks.
V-Bucks bought on PC, PlayStation, Xbox or mobile sit in one shared balance. V-Bucks bought on Nintendo Switch stay on Switch.

official_prices.heading: V-Bucks Prices: Official Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: Epic cut the V-Bucks in each pack on March 19, 2026 and kept the prices the same. Paying through Epic's own checkout also gives you 20% back in Epic Rewards.

extras.label: Fortnite Crew
extras.detail: $11.99/mo: 800 V-Bucks a month, the current passes and a monthly Crew skin

delivery.heading: How V-Bucks Delivery Works
steps: Pick an offer for your platform. Read the seller's delivery note before you pay.
After checkout, share what the seller asks for in the order chat: your Epic username and platform, or the details for a top-up.
If you get a V-Bucks code, redeem it at fortnite.com/vbuckscard while signed in to your Epic account.
Check your V-Bucks balance in Fortnite, then confirm the order.

support_topic.heading: Can You Gift V-Bucks in Fortnite?
paragraphs: No. Epic doesn't let you gift or transfer V-Bucks, and packs that contain V-Bucks can't be gifted either. You can only gift items that are in the Item Shop right now.
To send a gift you need two-factor authentication on, account level 2 or higher, and the friend must have been on your list for at least 2 days. You can send 5 gifts in any 24 hours.
Fortnite Crew and Battle Pass levels can't be gifted. Passes can only be gifted when bought with real money, not with V-Bucks.

faq_extra.q: Do V-Bucks work on every platform?
faq_extra.a: Mostly. V-Bucks bought on PC, PlayStation, Xbox or mobile share one balance. V-Bucks bought on Nintendo Switch only work on Switch, so tell your seller if you play there.

faq_extra.q: Where do I redeem a V-Bucks card?
faq_extra.a: At fortnite.com/vbuckscard, signed in to your Epic account. The code won't work in the PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo store.

faq_extra.q: How many V-Bucks is the Battle Pass?
faq_extra.a: 800 V-Bucks since March 19, 2026. It pays back 800 V-Bucks as you level it up.

notes: Prices: Engadget (2026-03-10) quoting Epic's announcement; fortnite.com itself is behind a Cloudflare JS wall so I could not read it directly. Our config bundles (800/2,400/4,500/12,500) match the post-March pack sizes. Crew $11.99 and 800 V-Bucks/month from third-party summaries (PCGamesN); medium confidence on the exact date the Crew stipend dropped (Engadget says with the March change, another source says June 6, 2026). Gifting rules from Epic help (search snippet; page not fetched in full). DELIVERY IS UNCLEAR: the config has no delivery method and the placeholder is generic; live listings only say 'PC' with no delivery note. V-Bucks can't be transferred between accounts, so sellers must use a code/gift card or log in to top up. The steps cover both and no_password is false. The current config FAQ ('Never share your password... game's own trade/gift system') is not true for V-Bucks and should be changed.
